title: Design System: Wheeler Cat — Variant A-rich (approved home)

variant.role: user-directed composition of A + B/C/G surfaces with services-commitment content shift

variant.cinematic: partial (Lenis runtime, scroll-reveal, hero load-fade; no register-driven kinetic-display)

items: typographyMeta (Roboto + Roboto Condensed for body/most surfaces)

displayHeadlineFamily.name: Oswald
displayHeadlineFamily.scope: hero h1 only — letterforms match captured wheelercat.com hero display proportions (more compressed than Roboto Condensed)
displayHeadlineFamily.rationale: Brand-faithful Mode A — Oswald was in the captured font inventory but unused by the original DESIGN-A spec. Restoring it for hero display matches the captured site's hero typographic register without inventing a new face.

displayHeadlineRules.twoToneTreatment: first line accent (Cat Yellow), second line on-dark (white)

supportingCopy.family: Roboto Condensed 700 caps (UP from original A's Roboto body)
supportingCopy.twoToneInline: yellow accent spans inline with white body (e.g. 'PARTNER WITH WHEELER' yellow / 'FOR YOUR EQUIPMENT...' white)
supportingCopy.italicVariant: second line uses font-style: italic (Roboto Condensed Italic synthesized)

ctaPillLight.scope: hero primary CTA (replaces dual btn-primary + btn-ghost-light pattern)

navVerbRow.structure: 4-verb Pattern A inline in main-header (BUY / RENT / SERVICE / PARTS)
navVerbRow.hoverState: dark-grey background #1a1a1a + yellow label + yellow sub-opacity 0.7
navVerbRow.dropdown: dark panel below header, yellow 3px top border, Roboto 400 mixed-case items
navVerbRow.rationale: Replaces original A's 7 captured nav links + 10 captured dept links with 4 verbs that absorb both rows under semantic categories. See nav-explorations.html for derivation.

items: More ▾ (dropdown with Online Payments, Rental Portal, Parts.Cat.com, SIS 2.0, Vision Link, Employee Login)
utilityStrip.rationale: Audience-coded simplification of captured 8-link utility row — visible items are customer-facing; staff/admin tools moved to More ▾

deptRow.rationale: Captured 10-link department row restored as 3rd header layer (kept per user direction)

hero.ground: Compact_Track_Loader photo (per H) with left-to-right gradient overlay
hero.headline: two-line: REDEFINING (yellow) / COMMITMENT (white)
hero.supportingCopy: Services-commitment lockup with inline yellow/white + italic second line
hero.cta: single white pill: 'Learn More About Our Services Commitment'
hero.loadMotion: CSS keyframe fade-in: eyebrow 100ms → headline 250ms → supporting 450ms → cta 650ms (not scroll-driven)
hero.rationale: Replaces A's finance-promo hero with services-commitment narrative anchored on the captured Compact_Track_Loader photo + operator imagery

financeBand.motion: data-anim slide-up + Card 1 numerals (60, 500) split-flap via data-flip
financeBand.rationale: Inherits from A; motion borrowed from C-cinematic finance card treatment

services.hoverTreatment: per-tile equipment image fades in as background with darkening gradient overlay (lighter at top, heavier at bottom for text contrast)
services.stickyReveal: once revealed via hover/focus, image stays visible (JS adds .is-revealed class with { once: true })
services.motion: data-anim entrance (same as finance cards per user direction)

cards.title: The Value of Preventative Equipment Maintenance
Aerial Lift Maintenance Tips and Checklist

blogCards.hoverTreatment: smooth image scale (1 → 1.08 over 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) via child .blog-card__bg element with overflow:hidden parent
blogCards.gradient: bottom-anchored dark gradient for title legibility (linear-gradient to top, rgba(18,18,18,0.92) 0% → transparent 70%)
blogCards.moreLink: Cat Yellow 'Read More ›' with arrow nudge on hover
blogCards.rationale: Per-user-screenshot reference of captured wheelercat.com blog index. Titles are real Wheeler blog topics.

brandLogos.layout: 5-up logo strip on white between blog cards and locations
brandLogos.logos: captured assets: Campbell, JLG, Monson, Gardner, SFS (no PLACEHOLDER)
brandLogos.treatment: grayscale 100%, opacity 0.7 default; full color + opacity 1 on hover

locations.topRibbon: thin yellow band (12px padding) holding 'FIND YOUR NEAREST BRANCH' in 0.85rem 0.12em condensed caps
locations.proofLine: white narrative proof (no entrance motion — user-directed removal)
locations.rationale: Replaces A's narrative-proof-on-white with G's yellow-ribbon-over-dark composition per user direction

motion.canonicalScript: embedded verbatim from skills/prototype/reference/motion-runtime.md, kinetic-display tuning (parallax 30, cards.slide 48, cards.stagger 0.16)
motion.register: partial-kinetic-display (no top-of-page marquee, no monogram unmask, no section-head word-clip-path reveals — user-directed removal)
moves: hero load-only CSS keyframe fade-in (NOT scroll-driven)
finance cards data-anim slide-up with stagger
finance card 1 numerals (60, 500) data-flip split-flap reveal
service tiles data-anim slide-up entrance (same as finance per user direction)
service tile image fade-in on hover (CSS only, sticky via JS .is-revealed)
blog card image scale on hover (CSS only)
motion.reducedMotionFallback: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) neutralizes all entrances + canonical runtime's prefersReducedMotion branch handles state pinning

hits.rule: Hero text on photographic background without contrast scrim
hits.justification: Left-to-right gradient overlay (0.85 → 0.10) provides 85% darkening on the left where text sits; AAA contrast preserved on white-on-darkened-photo
Captured wheelercat.com blog index uses this exact 3-up portrait pattern (user-referenced screenshot). The 4-up variant honors the captured composition with one extra card.

antiToolboxAudit.rationale: Composed variant with multi-source borrowing. All hits brand-faithfully resolved or captured-source justified.
